notes.title: Big Trouble In Little Chimney is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
I'm really excited to announce that the [b]Big Trouble In Little Chimney[/b] is OUT NOW!

Grab your Shotgun, finish your hot punch and don't forget your mission: Save the Christmas! 🎄

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3072710/Big_Trouble_in_Little_Chimney/

Even though the game is finished, I will continue to gather your suggestions to improve the game. If anyone has ideas about what they'd like to see, I'd love to hear them.

Thank you to everyone who supported me and my game during the development. Thanks for all your suggestions and feedback, you're all awesome!

And special thanks to my lovely wife Silvia for her GREAT patience :)

Have fun, folks!

@FobTi

notes.title: Update Patch Notes - May 17, 2018
notes.content:
[h1]The following updates have been implemented:[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26940807/7069d567b1749496b638dbd431c47e3d55070a6e.png[/img]

[b]Added:[/b] "Civilian Killed" to the Stats

[b]Added:[/b] Special abilities to some of the hats in the shop.
From now, your hat will be not only the ordinary fashion accessory :)

[b]Added:[/b] Description text for the hats.

[b]Fireman Helmet:[/b] You can walk through flames
[b]Top Hat:[/b] Enemies drop more money
[b]Police Cap:[/b] You start with bullet proof vest.
[b]Robocop:[/b] Enable Burst mode for your default weapon (pistol)
[b]Holy Pope Hat:[/b] Civilians will be imunne against your fire
[b]Chef's Hat:[/b] Chance to drop Big Donut (restore 3 HP)
[b]Cowboy Hat:[/b] You can fire 2x faster with your default weapon (pistol)
[b]Batman Mask:[/b] The little bat will be your new brother in arms.
[b]Frankenstein:[/b] Enables BlackWhite retro mode like in old movies.
[b]Pumpkinhead:[/b] Unlock Halloween mode

[b]Added (fixed)[/b] F12 key to take Screenshots


[b] Enjoy the game![/b] 

ps. And don't forget, I'm working on a new game called [b]"Gunman Tales"[/b] !

notes.title: Update Patch Notes - October 17, 2017
notes.content:
[h1]The HALLOWEEN update is here![/h1]

[b]This is a limited time event (October 17 - November 1)
Get that unique Achievements, Hats and Weapons before the event is ended![/b]

[b]The following updates have been implemented:[/b]

[b]Added[/b] 4 New Achievements
Mr. Pumpkin
Candyman
Witch Summoner
Ghostbuster

[u]The option to unlock these four achievements will be unavailable after November 1![/u]

[b]Added[/b] 3 New Hats
Pumpkin head
Batman
Frankenstein

[b]Added[/b] New Weapon (power-up)
The Witch
[i]Grab the witch hat and see... :)[/i]

[b]Added[/b] Pumpkins and Candies
Pumpkin = score +5
Candy = score +3

[b]Added[/b] Ghosts
Catch them all! :D

[b]Added[/b] more ammo for Freeze Gun :)

[b]Fixed / Changed[/b] the score system
[i]Now, if you die and use continue, the score will be reset.[/i]

[b]Fixed[/b] "Retro TV" mode
[i](wrong screen stretched)[/i]



[b]Enjoy the Halloween! Enjoy the game![/b]

ps. I'm working on a new game called "Gunman Tales" :) Stay tuned!

notes.title: Update Patch Notes - December 8, 2016
notes.content:
[h1]The following updates have been implemented:[/h1]

[b]Added:[/b] Headgear Shop! ːsteamhappyː
[i]You wanna be a Fireman, Doctor or maybe a Viking?? Just visit our new shop![/i]

[b]Fixed:[/b] Flamethrower on Thumbsucker difficulty.
[i]You can kill civilians without sanction with this weapon.[/i]

[b]Added:[/b] Collision zone for enemy van (Car Chase stage)
[i]Please drive carefully![/i]

[b]Fixed:[/b] Occasional bug at the very end of stage 2 (chinatown)
[i]Sometimes wasn't possible to complete this stage.[/i]

[b]Fixed:[/b] Occasional bug in two player game.
[i]Sometimes, the player 2 wasn't able to use "B" button on gamepad.[/i]

[b]Fixed:[/b] Combo King Achievement

[b]Changed:[/b] Mouse cursor is now hidden by default.
[i]This game does not support mouse :O[/i]

[b]Fixed:[/b] Enemy AI
[i]From now, enemies can follow you everywhere.
There was one terrible bug... Thanks to "RIEo" for bug report! :)[/i]

[b]Enjoy this update! :)[/b]

notes.title: Update Patch Notes - November 28, 2016
notes.content:
[h1]The following updates have been implemented:[/h1]

[b]Added:[/b] Difficulty Settings

[i]ThumbSucker: +75% more damage for primary weapon, -15% speed for enemy bullets, +9 grenades on start, You can kill civilians without sanction.[/i]

[i]Normal: +50% more damage for primary weapon, +5 grenades on start[/i]

[i]Nuck Chorris: Your primary weapon have normal damage, You start without Bullet Proof Vest, Enemies have +1 HP[/i]

[b]Added:[/b]Automatic save after each stage.
[i]In the main menu, you can choose New Game or Continue.[/i]

[b]Added:[/b] New Achievement ThumbSucker
[i]Finish the game on the ThumbSucker difficulty.[/i]


Enjoy the game! :)
